headline: Up to $15,000,000 in bond notes for the Apex Properties Project, plus the Tidewater Landing update and a legal contract renewal.
summary: Two invoices, from Jeanne Boyle Consulting, LLC and Municap, Inc., are also up for review. A closed-door session will cover public investments and several properties.
